items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had the More Moon band with Shadow Wilson and the tenor saxophone player that played so beautiful [Gene Ammons], and Ernie Wilkins. Yeah, Ernie Wilkins was there – no, Ernie Royal.

ctx.x: But it also sounds like he was letting other things happen.

He was. He was always very progressive. He had the More Moon band with Shadow Wilson and the tenor saxophone player that played so beautiful [Gene Ammons], and Ernie Wilkins. Yeah, Ernie Wilkins was there – no, Ernie Royal. He was always very progressive. He loved good music.
Sounds like he was not only musically progressive, but socially progressive.
